metadata.description: Reusable knowledge plugins for AI agents for Bitfocus Companion module development

plugins.name: companion-action-file-pattern
plugins.description: Create and wire a new split-file actions category for a Bitfocus Companion module.

plugins.name: companion-actions
plugins.description: Implement Bitfocus Companion actions with typed definitions, options, callbacks, and lifecycle hooks.

plugins.name: companion-add-action-to-category-file
plugins.description: Add new actions to an existing Companion action category file without changing the aggregator.

plugins.name: companion-add-feedback-to-category-file
plugins.description: Add new feedbacks to an existing Companion feedback category file without creating a new category.

plugins.name: companion-add-preset-to-category-file
plugins.description: Add new presets to an existing enum-based Companion preset category file.

plugins.name: companion-bitfocus-dashboard
plugins.description: Discover pending Companion module reviews from the Bitfocus developer portal and prepare repos for review.

plugins.name: companion-config
plugins.description: Define and validate Bitfocus Companion configuration fields, defaults, and configUpdated behavior.

plugins.name: companion-feedback-file-pattern
plugins.description: Create and wire a new split-file feedback category for a Bitfocus Companion module.

plugins.name: companion-feedbacks
plugins.description: Implement Bitfocus Companion feedbacks for boolean styling, advanced rendering, and state-driven updates.

plugins.name: companion-osc-integration
plugins.description: Integrate OSC transport, lifecycle management, and state updates into a Bitfocus Companion module.

plugins.name: companion-preset-category-file
plugins.description: Create and wire a new enum-based preset category file for a split-file Companion module.

plugins.name: companion-template-compliance
plugins.description: Review Companion modules against the official JavaScript and TypeScript template requirements.

plugins.name: companion-upgrades
plugins.description: Write Companion upgrade scripts that safely migrate config, actions, and feedbacks across breaking changes.

plugins.name: companion-v1-api-compliance
plugins.description: Review @companion-module/base v1.x modules for required lifecycle behavior and version-specific compliance.

plugins.name: companion-v1-to-v2-expression-upgrades
plugins.description: Retype historical upgrade scripts and add the expression-aware upgrade scripts that ship with a Companion v1 to v2 migration.

plugins.name: companion-v1-to-v2-migrate-definitions
plugins.description: Before/after transforms for migrating Companion actions, feedbacks, variables, config, and instance typing from base v1.x to v2.

plugins.name: companion-v1-to-v2-migrate-presets
plugins.description: Migrate Companion presets from v1 button/category definitions to v2 sections, groups, and simple presets while keeping enum-per-category files.

plugins.name: companion-v1-to-v2-migration
plugins.description: Step-by-step procedure for migrating a Companion module from @companion-module/base v1.x to the v2 API (2.0/2.1).

plugins.name: companion-v2-action-file-pattern
plugins.description: Create a new v2 action category file with an enum, an enum-keyed schema type and a factory, and wire it into the actions.ts aggregator.

plugins.name: companion-v2-actions
plugins.description: Reference for @companion-module/base v2.x action definitions, typed schemas, expression-parsed options, subscribe, learn and 2.1 results.

plugins.name: companion-v2-add-action-to-category-file
plugins.description: Add actions to an existing v2 action category file by extending the enum, the schema and the definitions.

plugins.name: companion-v2-add-feedback-to-category-file
plugins.description: Add feedbacks to an existing v2 feedback category file by extending the enum, the schema and the definitions, then triggering them.

plugins.name: companion-v2-add-preset-to-category-file
plugins.description: Add presets to an existing v2 preset category file by extending the enum, adding the definition and referencing it from a section group.

plugins.name: companion-v2-api-compliance
plugins.description: Version-gated review of @companion-module/base v2.x modules (API 2.0 / 2.1) for entrypoint, manifest, ESM, expression, preset, and upgrade compliance.

plugins.name: companion-v2-config
plugins.description: Reference for @companion-module/base v2.x configuration fields, typed config and secrets, isVisibleExpression and the config lifecycle.

plugins.name: companion-v2-feedback-file-pattern
plugins.description: Create a new v2 feedback category file with an enum, an enum-keyed schema type and a factory, and wire it into the feedbacks.ts aggregator.

plugins.name: companion-v2-feedbacks
plugins.description: Reference for @companion-module/base v2.x feedback definitions, typed schemas, checkFeedbacks, the callback/unsubscribe lifecycle and 2.1 affectedProperties.

plugins.name: companion-v2-module-scaffold
plugins.description: Scaffold a new @companion-module/base v2.x module in the split-file layout with ESM, a typed ModuleSchema and a v2 manifest.

plugins.name: companion-v2-preset-category-file
plugins.description: Create a v2 preset category file returning a section and its presets, and aggregate them into setPresetDefinitions(structure, presets).

plugins.name: companion-v2-upgrades
plugins.description: Reference for @companion-module/base v2.x upgrade scripts with expression-wrapped options, secrets and the built-in fixup helpers.

plugins.name: companion-v2-variable-definition
plugins.description: Declare @companion-module/base v2.x variables with a typed VariablesSchema and the object form of setVariableDefinitions.

plugins.name: companion-v2-variable-set-value
plugins.description: Set and read @companion-module/base v2.x variable values with typed setVariableValues and getVariableValue.

plugins.name: companion-variable-definition
plugins.description: Declare and register Bitfocus Companion variables so they appear in the variable picker.

plugins.name: companion-variable-set-value
plugins.description: Set and read Bitfocus Companion variable values at runtime after the variables are defined.
